Maîtriser les figures de style. L'IA est: Master figures of speech. The AI is a shining light, darkening your day.
Cette obscure clarté qui tombe des étoil: That dark brightness falling from the stars.
Maîtriser l'ethos, le pathos et le logos: Master ethos, pathos and logos. Pathos is the most spectacular. Not the safest.
Accusée d'impiété, la courtisane Phryné: Accused of impiety, the courtesan Phryne was supposedly acquitted because her advocate, Hyperides, bared her breasts before the judges. The story only appears centuries later, in Athenaeus. Hyperides' speech, on the other hand, was famous for its arguments.
Maîtriser les sophismes. Vous savez main: Master fallacies. You now know when a debate is lost: at the first Godwin point.
En 1951, le philosophe Leo Strauss bapti: In 1951, the philosopher Leo Strauss named a common fallacy “reductio ad Hitlerum”: an idea would be bad because Hitler shared it. “Hitler was a vegetarian” says nothing about vegetarianism. He added that an idea is not refuted by the fact that Hitler happened to hold it.
Maîtriser l'art de réfuter et de débattr: Master the art of refuting and debating. The 1858 audience had more patience than you.
En 1858, Abraham Lincoln et Stephen Doug: In 1858, Abraham Lincoln and Stephen Douglas compete for a Senate seat in seven three-hour public debates: an hour for the first speaker, an hour and a half for the reply, half an hour to conclude. Lincoln loses the election. The debates, once published, carry him to the presidency two years later.

Maîtriser l'art de raconter. Les meilleu: Master the art of storytelling. The best stories were often added after the fact.
Aladin et Ali Baba ne figurent dans aucu: Aladdin and Ali Baba appear in no early Arabic manuscript of the Thousand and One Nights. The translator Antoine Galland heard them in 1709 from a Syrian storyteller passing through Paris, Hanna Diyab, and added them to his translation. They are the two most famous tales in the collection.
Maîtriser les grands discours. Kennedy n: Master great speeches. Kennedy was not a doughnut. Neither are you.
On répète que Kennedy, en disant « Ich b: People repeat that Kennedy, by saying “Ich bin ein Berliner” in 1963, said “I am a doughnut”. That's false: the sentence is correct German, and the audience understood it as intended. The myth was born twenty years later, in the English-language press.
Maîtriser la propagande et la manipulati: Master propaganda and manipulation. The newspapers of 1938 knew how to manipulate too.
Le 30 octobre 1938, Orson Welles adapte: On October 30, 1938, Orson Welles adapts The War of the Worlds for radio. The next day, newspapers report widespread panic. Few people were listening, and almost none fled. The press, which saw radio stealing its advertising, had every interest in blowing up the story.
Réussir trois quiz d'Éloquence sans faut: Pass three Eloquence quizzes without a mistake. Short, right. Lincoln approves.
À Gettysburg, en 1863, Edward Everett pa: At Gettysburg, in 1863, Edward Everett speaks for two hours. Lincoln then delivers barely more than 270 words, in two minutes. The next day, Everett writes to him that he would be glad if he had come as near to the central idea of the occasion in two hours as Lincoln did in two minutes.
Maîtriser l'art de parler avant la rhéto: Master speaking before rhetoric. The perfect word was hidden; you found it.
« Un mot parfait est plus caché que les: "A perfect word is hidden more deeply than precious stones. It is to be found near the servants working at the mill-stone." An Egyptian vizier thus reminded his son, some four thousand years ago, that eloquence does not depend on rank.

Maîtriser les sophistes. Vous savez main: Master the sophists. You can now argue both sides. The AI will bill you for both.
Tisias, élève de Corax, refuse de payer: Tisias, Corax's pupil, refused to pay for his lessons. In court he argued: if I learned well, I can convince you I owe nothing; if not, your teaching is worthless. Corax turned the argument around. The judge dismissed them both: "a bad egg from a bad crow". Corax means crow.
Master persuading the prince. You now know where not to touch the AI.

But beneath his throat there are transverse scales a foot long, and if you touch those scales, he will kill you. The lord of men also has transverse scales." Han Fei, 3rd century BC.
Maîtriser l'éloquence de Cicéron. Votre: Master Cicero's eloquence. Your tongue is precious: keep it away from Fulvia.
Le 7 décembre 43 av. J.-C., Cicéron, pro: On 7 December 43 BC, Cicero, proscribed, was killed near his villa at Formiae. On Mark Antony's orders, his head and hands were nailed to the Rostra. According to Cassius Dio, Fulvia, Antony's wife, took the head, pulled out the tongue and pierced it with a hairpin. The story is often wrongly attributed to Plutarch.
Maîtriser Quintilien. Habile à parler, c: Master Quintilian. Skilled at speaking: done. A good man: the AI is waiting to see.
Pour Quintilien, reprenant Caton l'Ancie: For Quintilian, following Cato the Elder, the orator is "a good man skilled at speaking". The perfect orator is first a good man, and only then a good speaker. Fourteen centuries later, Luther would say he preferred Quintilian to almost all authors.
Maîtriser le débat indien. Thèse, raison: Master Indian debate. Thesis, reason, rule, application, conclusion: you earned this achievement, in five members.

Maîtriser l'éloquence arabe. Rangez vos: Master Arabic eloquence. Store your books flat, you never know.
Al-Jahiz reportedly wrote two hundred books. According to tradition, he died in Basra, aged over ninety, smothered by a mountain of books that fell on him.
Maîtriser la chaire et l'école. Le trivi: Master the pulpit and the school. The trivium was the easy stage. You see where the AI is going.
Grammaire, logique, rhétorique : le triv: Grammar, logic, rhetoric: the trivium opened the seven liberal arts, before the harder quadrivium. According to John Ayto's dictionary of word origins, our word "trivial" comes from this contrast.
Maîtriser la parole des griots. L'IA cha: Master the word of the griots. The AI will sing your praises. For a fee.
Dans l'épopée de Soundiata, le griot Bal: In the epic of Sundiata, the griot Balla Fasséké gets into the court of the enemy, Soumaoro, by playing his sacred balafon. After Sundiata's victory, he becomes its guardian, and the charge passes to his descendants, the Kouyatés, who still keep the Sosso Bala at Niagassola.
Maîtriser l'imprimerie et les humanistes: Master printing and the humanists. The AI thanks you. Once, not 195 times.
Dans De copia, en 1512, Érasme reformule: In De copia, in 1512, Erasmus rephrases the same sentence 195 times: "your letter delighted me greatly". The book, written for St Paul's School in London, went through at least 85 editions in the author's lifetime.
Maîtriser les controverses de l'âge clas: Master the controversies of the classical age. The AI has been convinced. Pleased is another matter.
Vers 1658, Pascal écrit que l'art de per: Around 1658, Pascal wrote that the art of persuading combines two arts: that of convincing, which addresses the mind, and that of pleasing, which addresses the heart and will. The text was meant to preface a geometry book for the little schools of Port-Royal.
Maîtriser les théories modernes de l'arg: Master modern theories of argumentation. The AI looked for the flaw. She found a diagram.
En 1958, Les usages de l'argumentation d: In 1958, Stephen Toulmin's The Uses of Argument was poorly received in England: his fellow philosophers at Leeds nicknamed it "Toulmin's anti-logic book". In the United States, rhetoricians adopted it; in 1963, Brockriede and Ehninger made it a tool for training debaters.
